common.unsubscribe: Don't want to receive these emails? Unsubscribe

email_otp.subject: Verify Your Email - OTP Code
email_otp.title: Verify Your Email Address
email_otp.message: Thank you for signing up with Newcondo. Please use the code below to verify your email address:
email_otp.no_request: If you didn't request this code, please ignore this email.

phone_otp.subject: Verify Your Phone Number - OTP Code
phone_otp.title: Verify Your Phone Number
phone_otp.message: Please use the code below to verify your phone number:

approved.subject: Account Verified Successfully!
approved.title: Verification Approved
approved.message: Congratulations! Your Newcondo account has been verified. You now have full access to all our features.

rejected.subject: Account Verification Rejected
rejected.title: Verification Rejected
rejected.message: Unfortunately, we couldn't verify your account at this time.
rejected.next_steps: Please resubmit your verification documents with the following corrections:

approved.subject: Property Listing Approved - {{propertyTitle}}
approved.title: Your Property is Live!
approved.message: Great news! Your property listing '{{propertyTitle}}' has been approved and is now visible to potential renters.

rejected.subject: Property Listing Rejected - {{propertyTitle}}
rejected.title: Property Listing Requires Updates
rejected.message: Your property listing '{{propertyTitle}}' requires some updates before approval.
rejected.next_steps: Please make the necessary changes and resubmit your listing.

rented.subject: Your Property Has Been Rented - {{propertyTitle}}
rented.title: Congratulations on Your New Tenant!
rented.message: Your property '{{propertyTitle}}' has been successfully rented.

receipt.subject: Payment Receipt - {{transactionId}}
receipt.title: Payment Confirmation
receipt.message: Thank you for your payment. Here are the details:

confirmation_required.subject: Action Required: Confirm Your Payment
confirmation_required.title: Please Confirm Your Payment
confirmation_required.message: You have {{hours}} hours remaining to confirm your rent payment for '{{propertyTitle}}'.
confirmation_required.warning: If not confirmed within this period, your payment will be refunded minus transaction fees.
confirmation_required.step1: 1. Visit the property and verify it matches the listing
confirmation_required.step3: 3. Click the confirmation button in your dashboard

released.subject: Payment Released - {{amount}} {{currency}}
released.title: Funds Released
released.message: Your payment of {{amount}} {{currency}} has been released and is now available in your virtual account.

refunded.subject: Payment Refunded - {{transactionId}}
refunded.title: Refund Processed
refunded.message: Your payment has been refunded to your original payment method.
refunded.processing_time: Please allow 5-10 business days for the refund to appear in your account.

job_assigned.subject: New Marking Job Available - {{location}}
job_assigned.title: New Marking Opportunity
job_assigned.message: A new property marking job is available in your area:

agent_assigned.subject: Agent Assigned to Mark Your Property
agent_assigned.title: Marking Job Assigned
agent_assigned.message: An agent has been assigned to mark your property '{{propertyTitle}}'.

job_completed.subject: Property Marking Completed - Action Required
job_completed.title: Please Confirm Property Marking
job_completed.message: Your property '{{propertyTitle}}' has been marked. Please review and confirm within {{days}} days.
job_completed.warning: Failure to confirm will result in partial payments to the agent until the marking fee is exhausted.

reward_earned.subject: You've Earned a Referral Reward!
reward_earned.title: Referral Reward Credited
reward_earned.message: Congratulations! {{referredName}} completed their registration using your referral code.

new_verification.subject: New Verification Request - {{userName}}
new_verification.title: New Verification Pending
new_verification.message: {{userName}} has submitted documents for account verification.

new_property.subject: New Property Submission - {{propertyTitle}}
new_property.title: Property Approval Required
new_property.message: A new property listing requires your review.

dispute_reported.subject: Boundary Dispute Reported - {{propertyTitle}}
dispute_reported.title: Dispute Resolution Required
dispute_reported.message: A boundary dispute has been reported for property '{{propertyTitle}}'.

password_reset.subject: Reset Your Password
password_reset.title: Password Reset Request
password_reset.message: We received a request to reset your password. Use the code below:
password_reset.no_request: If you didn't request a password reset, please ignore this email and your password will remain unchanged.
